alt: Using bisect_right to count how many recorded days fall on or before a query day, even when the query day was never one of the recorded values.

steps.caption: 4 distinct days were recorded. bisect_right finds where a query day would sit among them, even one that was never recorded.
Day 5 sits before every recorded day. bisect_right returns 0: that many recorded days are on or before day 5.
Day 10 sits between day 10 and day 20. bisect_right returns 1: that many recorded days are on or before day 10.
Day 25 sits between day 20 and day 45. bisect_right returns 3: that many recorded days are on or before day 25.
Day 45 sits after every recorded day. bisect_right returns 4: that many recorded days are on or before day 45.
Day 1000000000 sits after every recorded day. bisect_right returns 4: that many recorded days are on or before day 1000000000.
